newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bk of E.Asia plans 1-for-five bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Bk of E.Asia plans 1-for-five bonus issue.

text.p: Bank of East Asia said on Monday it will propose to make a bonus issue on the basis of one share for every five shares held at its annual general meeting on April 8.
The bank will issue 220.75 million new shares under the proposed bonus issue, it said in a statement.
The commercial bank earlier announced a final cash dividend of 54.5 H.K. cents for calendar 1996 versus 45.8 cents the previous year.

Bank of East Asia posted a 14.5 percent rise on its annual net profit for 1996 to HK$1.88 billion, including an exceptional pre-tax profit of HK$28.27 million from sales of the remaining residential units of the Kennedy Town development project.
